dog.description_text: Bridget is the sweetest girl with the perfect mix of playful and cuddly. She loves going on walks, playing with other dogs, and exploring the neighborhood, but she takes her nap time very seriously. Her favorite way to snooze is curled up on the couch with her head completely buried in the cushions. She’s incredibly affectionate, loves being around her people, and is happiest just being included in whatever you’re doing. Whether she’s out on a walk, playing with a new dog friend, or snoozing beside you at home, Bridget is an easy girl to fall in love with.
dog.name: Bridgerton
